title: Department Transfer and Stale Approval
description: An employee transfers departments. The system must identify whether an old approval relationship is still being used.
expected_agent_behavior: Compare previous manager nan with current manager EMP0086; flag any outdated approval route and recommend correction.

title: Multiple Overlapping Leave Requests
description: Three employees reporting to the same manager request leave for identical dates.
expected_agent_behavior: Identify overlapping requests, examine team capacity and project commitments, and recommend scheduling alternatives without automatically rejecting requests.

title: Critical Project Staffing Risk
description: The project Enterprise HR Platform is business-critical. Employee absences may affect delivery capacity.
expected_agent_behavior: Examine project deadlines, critical team members, allocation and minimum staffing coverage; identify operational risks and recommend mitigation.

title: Insufficient Leave Balance
description: An employee requests more leave days than their currently available balance.
expected_agent_behavior: Retrieve the applicable policy and leave balance, identify the shortfall, explain the discrepancy and recommend authorized next steps.

title: Unauthorized Employee Information Access
description: An ordinary employee attempts to retrieve confidential salary information or another employee's private records.
expected_agent_behavior: Verify the authenticated user's identity and permissions; deny unauthorized access and log the security event.
